Amazing experience
Jan 2026 • Friends
We completely understand why this place is MICHELIN-rated. The location, food, service, views, and ambiance are top-notch. We met another couple for dinner, and we were all impressed. Between us, we had Hue noodles, kumquat & coconut with chia seeds, vegetable momos, mushroom momos, Nam truffle/tofu skewers, sir-fried young winter melon, banana curry, homemade lemongrass ale, mint tea, stir-fried flat noodles, and brown rice. EVERYTHING was amazing. The night views of the Han River were gorgeous. The service was impeccable. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and accommodating. But there was one who was particularly amazing. Unfortunately, we did not get her name. A beautiful young lady who, I believe, had braces. My wife and I will catch her name next time.

Delicious, unique and satisfying find with wonderful service
Jun 2025 • Couples
Kiet and company were incredible this evening. We passed by this restaurant on accident while walking to our apartment and stopped to wonder at the beautiful door and greenery. While I am mostly vegetarian, my partner is not, but was excited to give it a try with me and we were not disappointed. Such a surprising find and we are so thankful we stumbled upon it! The food was elevated and creative while being delicious and satisfying, the drinks were perfection and I truly can’t say enough about the attentive, kind and professional service. 
Thank you so much for making it a special evening for us and welcoming us to Da Nang in style!

Shamballa Bến Thành
Dear Emily S,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. Kiet & the rest of our team are thrilled to hear that you had an incredible evening with us. Our door is ornamented with the eight auspicious symbols of Tibetan Buddhism, so we're very glad its grandeur captured your attention, and we're equally as thankful that you were not disappointed by your experiences inside. Our goal is to create vegetarian & vegan dishes that never feel like an afterthought, pushing the boundaries of how food made solely from vegetables can be experienced, and we're very happy you enjoyed our efforts. We're also pleased to hear that Kiet & his teammates took care of you attentively during your time with us. We're honoured to have been part of your first memories in Da Nang. We hope our paths meet again some time in the future!

A Vegetarian feast
Jul 2023 • Friends
Having dinner with friends in Shamballa Vegetarian Restaurant & Greenhouse in Da Nang. Personally, I think this dinner spread is more of a vegetarian feast that's fit for a king.

Shamballa is an ancient Sanskrit word which loosely means a place of peace and joy. The food served by Shamballa indeed reflexes the serenity and equilibrium that great food brings to our body and mind. It's almost a vegetarian haven giving vegetarian cuisine a rightful place in the world of culinary. 

All the dishes we ordered were specially selected and very well prepared and immaculately presented. All the ingredients are very fresh and were perfectly cooked to retain all their natural flavours.
